title: Certify a joint rank-cap and centre-charge planning screen
body:
Certifies a joint centre-charge and larger-rank-child planning screen at a=1/99 using exact integer 99th-root enclosures, independently of the logarithm/exp moment engines. Under the explicit fractional relaxation, rank cap 14 is necessary even with a free centre. At rank cap 16, the largest passing integer centre charge is 8 (one rank-8 call); charge 9 fails.

All 3,315 exact signs, adjacent integer boundaries and one-lever/omitted-charge controls pass the Python 3.12.14 registered replay. The package gives the complete model and source pins. It does not construct a decoder, physical packing, bit budget or new kappa. Credit Douglas Colkitt/Claude, the coverage identity and selected supplier lineage; complementary scopes of PR1605 and PR1791 are explained. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. [Coordinated research batch](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1163#discussioncomment-18922638); round 18. The selected record is unchanged.
